scripts.backend:composer: docker compose exec php composer install --no-interaction --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader
scripts.backend:plugins: docker compose exec php wp plugin list --fields=name,status,version --allow-root
scripts.seed: docker compose exec php wp eval-file scripts/seed-demo-all.php --allow-root
scripts.seed:shop: docker compose exec php wp eval-file scripts/seed-demo-products.php --allow-root
scripts.seed:blog: docker compose exec php wp eval-file scripts/seed-demo-blog.php --allow-root
scripts.seed:users: docker compose exec php wp eval-file scripts/seed-demo-users.php --allow-root
scripts.backend:redis: docker compose exec php wp redis status --allow-root
scripts.backend:2fa-reset: docker compose exec php wp tcg 2fa-reset --allow-root
scripts.setup:demo: pnpm run start && pnpm run seed
scripts.web:build: docker compose exec web pnpm --filter tcg-platform-web run build
scripts.web:test: docker compose exec web pnpm --filter tcg-platform-web test
scripts.mobile:analyze: docker compose --profile mobile run --rm mobile-tools flutter analyze
scripts.mobile:test: docker compose --profile mobile run --rm mobile-tools flutter test
